title: It’s nice... but don’t wash with Clorox2 for colors!
text: It’s nice... but don’t wash with Clorox2 for colors!. Bought this for $22 in Used/Like New condition, otherwise I’d probably be really unhappy with it. Aesthetically, it’s pleasing to the eye—my 12 year old loves it. IMO, the teal-ish colored stripe is closer to light and darker variations of a royal blue, which still adds that pop of color, but it’s definitely not navy. I actually bought navy sheets with it after reading other reviews about the color and had to exchange them for gray because navy did NOT match. The plaid fabric is a little stiff but seems durable. My biggest complaint is that the solid gray back looks a little peachy tie-dye discolored after 1 wash using Clorox2 for colors, so I definitely don’t recommend using that product on it. Overall, for what I paid, and the fact that the back is hidden, it’s good.
